observations: The binary-record suites preserved the telemetry bytes, every truncated prefix, optional metadata and hash bytes, signed composite values, footer and named error precedence.
Both geology package consumers passed their native tests, including the independent codec and slot width observations. Repeated assembly produced identical Rust sources and package locks.
The garden caller compared original and projected wire behavior and detected the guard-order mutation. Repeated recovery and reordered projection preserved artifact bytes.
The scalar-byte caller passed as a standalone consumer and an external example of the source-free package. The hash caller matched all three independently calculated SHA-256 results.
